evidence: The default namespace project and greeter-service appear as Domain System and Component entities without anyone writing catalog files; not every entry names an owning team
The Create page has a Create Project wizard and a Create Component wizard for each ComponentType (service web-application scheduled-task worker); there is no per-language template library
The component page shows deployments per environment and logs and opens a shell into a running instance; no runbooks or SLOs are attached
Access control shows roles and bindings; the Audit Logs page lists who changed what and whether it was allowed
Logs metrics and traces open from the component page through the observability plane the pre-work installed
A Cost Insights page exists but needs a FinOps module such as OpenCost to show data; no engineering analytics; the SRE and FinOps agents are off by default
